_comment: TEMPLATE with SYNTHETIC values. Copy to profile/profile.json (gitignored) and edit. Every field is optional. name / city override what Strava reports; birthdate gives the age (computed by the page, never stored); devices: type = watch | bike-computer | ems | other, since = YYYY-MM, manual = the file name of its PDF manual in data/gear/ (optional, a bare name like x-manual.pdf; the LAN page links it); hiddenDevices: device names left out of the list (e.g. one Strava saw once), case-insensitive; supplements: meal = breakfast | lunch | preworkout | postworkout | dinner | snack (shown under that meal in Nutrición, no macros), dose is free text; events: upcoming races, date = YYYY-MM-DD, type = hyrox | race | sportive | other (optional), location optional (the page shows the days to go).
name: Sam Sample
